subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Graded reader 2: A Rock Climbing Adventure
outcomes: Read a story and follow the order of events.
Learn the words equipment, falcon, nest, flap and proud.
Give your opinion about the characters' actions.

tf.s: The boys went rock climbing in the north of Oman.
tf.why: Yes, the story happens in the north of Oman.

tf.s: The boys saw the sunset before they got to the cliffs.
tf.why: They saw the sunrise, early in the morning.

tf.s: The baby falcon had fallen out of its nest.
tf.why: Correct, it had fallen out of its nest.

tf.s: Sultan saw a baby falcon sitting on its nest.
tf.why: The baby falcon had fallen out of its nest.

tf.s: Adil climbed the cliff with the baby falcon.
tf.why: Right, Adil took the baby back up.

tf.s: The boys took a bus down the cliff.
The boys knew how to climb because they had taken lessons.
tf.why: Well done, they had taken climbing lessons.

tf.s: A nest is a home that birds build for their eggs and babies.
Dad was angry because Adil helped the baby falcon.
The falcon's mother was making noises.
tf.why: Good, the mother bird was making noises.

boxes.q: Where did the boys go rock climbing?
boxes.why: They climbed in the north of Oman.

boxes.q: What had happened to the baby falcon?
o: It had fallen out of its nest.
It had flown to the sea.
boxes.why: It had fallen out of its nest.

boxes.q: Who climbed the cliff with the baby?
boxes.why: Adil climbed up with the baby falcon.

boxes.q: How did the boys get down the cliff?

o: very pleased about someone's good action
boxes.why: Dad was proud because Adil did something good.

boxes.q: What do birds do when they flap?
o: move their wings up and down
boxes.why: Flap means move the wings up and down.

boxes.q: Complete: The boys had ___ lessons, so they knew how to climb.
What did they see before they got to the cliffs?
boxes.why: They saw the sunrise on the way.

boxes.q: Ropes and helmets for climbing are called ...
boxes.why: Equipment is the things you need for an activity.

hunt.q: Part of Oman in the story

o: go down a cliff on a rope
mcq.why: The boys abseiled down the cliff on ropes.
Helping the baby falcon made Dad proud.

mcq.q: What was the falcon's mother doing?
Complete the summary: The boys ___ down the cliff.
mcq.why: Abseil means go down a cliff on a rope.

mcq.q: Correct the sentence: 'Sultan saw a baby falcon on its nest.'
o: The baby falcon had fallen out of its nest.
The falcon was in the sea.
mcq.why: The baby was not on its nest; it had fallen out.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the Past perfect correctly?
o: The baby falcon had fallen out of its nest.
The baby falcon had fell out of its nest.
The baby falcon has fall out of its nest.
The baby falcon falling had out of its nest.

mcq.q: Why could the boys climb the cliff safely?
o: They had taken lessons and had the right equipment.
mcq.why: Lessons and equipment helped them climb safely.

o: The baby falcon fell out of its nest.
Adil climbed the cliff with the baby.
mcq.why: The fall happened first; then Adil helped and they came down.

mcq.q: A student says Adil was brave. Which reason supports this?
o: He climbed a cliff to take the baby back to its nest.
mcq.why: Climbing the cliff to help the bird shows courage.
